gen-gf-oxanium-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada has tall, squared-off lowercase with open curves. Oxanium sets against it with monoline strokes and a lowercase a free of any hairlines, which is the sharpest difference here.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-anek-latin: Tall, tubular, unmistakable: Oxanium's heading letters keep one line width throughout. Anek Latin follows with lowercase nearly touching the capitals, and a larger size for the heading would let that difference show.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-anek-malayalam: Oxanium opens with a monoweight stroke from start to finish, big lowercase and curves ending in clear daylight. Anek Malayalam reads smooth and sans-serif underneath.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-anek-odia: Strokes like bent copper pipe define Oxanium's heading. Anek Odia counters with rounds left unsealed, like an unlatched hook, and capitals barely above the lowercase.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil reads big and round, its c and s looking half unwrapped. And Oxanium hums above it in a flat gray line weight, so the heading feels machined while the text stays soft.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-anek-telugu: Oxanium makes no visible difference between its upright and sideways strokes, giving every heading a built, commanding look. Anek Telugu does the quieter job, wide tall bowls carrying the reading.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-anuphan: Commanding is how Oxanium looks, with joints that never thin or bulge where strokes meet. Anuphan carries on below in big round bowls and open curves, easy on the eye.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-arimo: Arimo reads like plain sans with a tall mean line and spacious gaps inside its rounds. Oxanium above it looks drawn with a ballpoint pen, and the text underneath moves along without tiring.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-armata: Armata fills most of its letter height with lowercase and spaces its characters generously. Oxanium does the loud work, round letters with walls as heavy as the straight ones, while Armata keeps the reading easy.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-athiti: Athiti reads friendly, with a see-through gap in every s and a high mean line. Oxanium handles the commanding work up top, and Athiti does the gentle reading below.
